# claudje

> claudje is an AI-powered competitor intelligence service for SMBs. It monitors competitors' pricing, reviews, web activity, and public filings, then delivers a structured weekly report straight to your inbox. Plans start at EUR 60/mo.

claudje deploys a team of specialized AI agents — each handling a different research domain — to systematically analyze publicly available competitor data. Unlike generic AI chatbots that summarize the first page of Google, claudje cross-references real data from multiple sources (Google Maps reviews, Chamber of Commerce filings, LinkedIn activity, pricing pages, and more) into one comprehensive report.

Founded by Berend Harms (BBA University of Amsterdam, MSc Innovation, Technology and Entrepreneurship at Bocconi). Based in the Netherlands and Italy.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://claudje.com/): Main landing page with product overview, how it works, pricing, and FAQ
- [About](https://claudje.com/about): Company background, team, and mission
- [Pricing](https://claudje.com/#pricing): Two plans — Starter (EUR 60/mo, 5 competitors, weekly reports) and Pro (EUR 100/mo, 10 competitors, daily reports)
- [Get Started](https://claudje.com/get-started): Sign up for a 14-day free trial

## What claudje Monitors

- Competitor pricing and product changes
- Google Maps and online review scores
- Website and digital activity changes
- Company registry and public filings (KVK / Chamber of Commerce)
- LinkedIn and social media activity
- Search trends and market positioning

## Industries Served

claudje works for any industry where competitors have a web presence, including retail and e-commerce, hospitality, professional services, automotive, healthcare and dental, and construction and trade.

## Blog

- [What Is Competitor Monitoring](https://claudje.com/blog/what-is-competitor-monitoring): Explains competitor monitoring, what it covers, manual vs. automated approaches, and how SMBs can get started
- [How to Monitor Competitor Pricing](https://claudje.com/blog/how-to-monitor-competitor-pricing): Step-by-step guide to tracking competitor pricing, common pitfalls, and how AI-powered pricing intelligence works
- [Competitor Intelligence Tools for Small Business](https://claudje.com/blog/competitor-intelligence-tools-small-business): Honest comparison of free methods, SEO tools, enterprise platforms, and AI-powered services for SMBs

## FAQ

- How does claudje collect data? AI agents analyze publicly available information only — websites, pricing pages, review platforms, company registries, social media, and search trends. No scraping of private data.
- When do I get my first report? Within 24 hours of sharing your competitor list.
- Is this legal? Yes. claudje only analyzes publicly available information — the same data anyone could find by visiting competitor websites or checking the Chamber of Commerce.
- How is this different from ChatGPT? claudje uses specialized sub-agents with paid tool access for each research domain. A chatbot summarizes one page of Google; claudje cross-references real data from multiple sources.
